description: Get a signed PUT for a local file. Upload exactly the declared byte count, then pass upload_id to enhance_media. Keep that upload_id for retries of the same job submission. For a keyless upload, upload_id is sufficient. Keep the ID and upload URL private.

anonymous_session.description: Optional keyless session credential for grouping calls and retries. Omit it when submitting an anonymous upload by upload_id or reading an anonymous job by job_id.
